Class PracticeResult

java.lang.Object
aslframework.game.result.PracticeResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameResult
public class PracticeResult extends Object implements GameResult
Immutable result for a completed practice session.

Carries practice-specific data: the total score (including perfect-run bonuses), how many letters were cleared, and the full attempt history.
